scope: Exact selector-target evaluation-row lemma and actual-degree controls in SELECTOR_TARGET_LEMMA.md; characteristic greater than 3; no generic solver or signed group-relation conclusion
statement: If target abscissa X lies in the split selector V, then H(X,t)=P_V(t); reduction modulo any nonzero monic divisor of P_V therefore has rank at most min(d-1,e). A nonsingular 2-torsion target gives distinct rational right degree d outside V and d-1 inside V. Written derivations only.
